title: Law to set up doula resources and an advisory council
summary: This bill would require the city Health Department to create a doula bill of rights explaining laws on hospital access, and a form for doulas to report their experiences working in city hospitals, with annual public summaries. It would also establish a doula advisory council of doulas, birthing parents and city officials to study doula services and advise the Citywide Doula Program, meeting quarterly and reporting findings to the mayor and Council speaker.
